title: Treasures of Japan | Timeless Temples and Modern Wonders
highlights: Explore Japan’s cultural highlights with Kyoto’s temples, Tokyo’s urban districts, and Osaka’s vibrant streets, offering a glimpse into the country’s rich heritage.
Walk through Arashiyama’s bamboo grove, a pathway lined with endless green stalks, creating a unique and peaceful atmosphere that feels otherworldly.
Visit Kinkaku-ji Temple, known for its gold-leaf design, a remarkable example of Japanese architecture and history.
Witness panoramic views of Mt. Fuji and the surrounding Fuji Five Lakes from the 5th Station, a prime spot for capturing the beauty of Japan's tallest peak.
Visit Owakudani Valley in Hakone, an active volcanic region known for its bubbling sulfur vents and hot spring.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be driven to your hotel. Check in & spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can explore the vibrant Ginza district, known for its luxury shopping & fine dining options. You can also relax at the Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden or visit the Tsukiji Hongan-ji Buddhist temple, known for its Indian architectural influences. Additionally, you can spend the day at Tokyo Disneyland, home to various thrilling rides.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day by heading to the pick-up point- LOVE Sculpture. Board your transfer & visit various places like Meji Jingu Shrine, Imperial Palace & Takeshita Street. See the iconic Tokyo Tower and visit Senso-ji Temple, the city’s oldest temple. Discover the vibrant Odaiba District, known for its shopping & entertainment options. Conclude the tour with breathtaking city views from Tokyo Skytree. Later, get driven to 1-chōme-7-2 Nishishinjuku. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Excursion To Mount Fuji and Hakone
days.desc: Today, embark on a day trip to Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Head to Giulio Paolini Sculpture: "Kaleidoscorpio & get driven to Japan's iconic Mt. Fuji. Relish its breathtaking views from the 5th Station. Continue to see Mt. Hakone, which offers a peaceful retreat away from the bustling city. Enjoy an exciting ropeway ride and explore the unique geothermal wonders of Owakudani Valley. End your tour at Odawara Station, where you'll hop aboard a bullet train for a return to Tokyo Station.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check out, proceed to Tokyo Station to board the bullet train for Kyoto. Upon arrival, head to the hotel on your own. Check in & enjoy the day at leisure. You can set out to discover Kyoto at your own pace. You can visit Nijo Castle, known for its unique "chirping" floors designed to alert against intruders. You can even visit the Kyoto National Museum, showcasing a rich collection of Japanese art and cultural artifacts, including samurai armor. Afterward, return to the hotel.

days.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the pick-up point- Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit to begin the Kyoto & Nara sightseeing tour. Board your transfer & visit the Kinkakuji Temple, known for its golden pavilion. Next, explore the scenic Arashiyama District, famous for its bamboo grove and peaceful atmosphere, followed by a visit to Nara Park, where you'll have a chance to interact with friendly deer. After the tour, get driven back to the meeting point, from where you can head to your hotel on your own.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Kyoto Departure/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Lesiure
days.desc: Check out and proceed to Kyoto Station to catch a bullet train to Osaka. Upon arriving, make your way to the hotel on your own and complete the check-in process. Spend the rest of the day exploring Osaka at your leisure. You can explore the historic Osaka Castle or wander through Den Den Town, a hub for shopping, dining, and pop culture enthusiasts. You can even visit Spa World & enjoy its wellness treatments and themed spa zones. Later, return to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel & then, get driven to the Kansai International Airport. Board your flight back home with pleasant memories of the trip.
